meetings.ours_headline: Parks Commission heard skate park, youth baseball and Marshall Park updates; no formal votes beyond adjournment.
Parks Commission set seasonal beach staff dates and heard Marshall Park funding plan; chair-critical member Dave leaving.

votes.motion: Move that the seasonal employees application be submitted to the state with the dates of May 8 through September 22, 2023.
votes.quote: k. menard made a motion requesting the seasonal employees application be submitted to the state with the dates of

votes.motion: Approve the minutes from January 2023.
votes.quote: k. menard made a motion to approve the minutes from january 2023. d. passios seconded. roll call vote, (4-0-1) motion carried.

votes.motion: Adjourn the Parks Commission meeting at 8:14 p.m.
votes.quote: k. menard motioned and d. passios seconded to adjourn at 8:14pm. passed 3-0.

meetings.ours_headline: Parks Commission voted 3-2 to keep Town Beach fees unchanged and reviewed Marshall Park schematic design and the cave.

votes.motion: Recommend hiring the returning lifeguards for the 2023 beach season.
votes.quote: c. sullivan made a motion to recommend the hiring of the returning lifeguards for the 2023 beach season. k. menard seconded.

votes.motion: Recommend approval of Elizabeth Simeone as Beach Director, pending confirmation of completion of her Water Safety Instructor training.
votes.quote: k. menard made a motion to recommend approvalof elizabeth simeone to the position of beach director pending confirmation of the completion of her water safety instructor training.

votes.motion: Leave the town beach fees as they were for last year on all levels.
votes.quote: d. passios made a motion to leave the fees as they were for last year on all levels. c. sullivan seconded. roll call vote (3-2).

votes.motion: Allow the Lunenburg Youth Baseball/Softball League to place banners along the field's fence, with no political signs, removed at the end of the season.
votes.quote: a. lockwood made a motion to allow banners along the fence, no political signs and to be removed at the end of the season. k. menard seconded.

votes.motion: Require permission from the Parks Commission before planned trapping for the purpose of removal or destruction of wildlife.
votes.quote: k. menard made a motion requiring permission from the parks commission before planned trapping for purpose of removal or destruction of wildlife. a. lockwood seconded. roll call vote (5-1).

votes.motion: Approve the minutes from February 15, 2023.
votes.quote: k. menard made a motion to approve the minutes from february 15, 2023. a. lockwood seconded.

votes.motion: Within the Commission's policies and procedures, change the phrase DPW Director to Facilities Director in the forms.
votes.quote: c. sullivan made a motion within our policies and procedures to change the phrase dpw director to facilities director: a. lockwood seconded.

meetings.ours_headline: Parks Commission backed a native memorial tree at the town beach and a June 2024 skate park deadline; beach renaming deferred.

votes.motion: Accept the donation of a native tree as a memorial to Gen Ness, Cheryl Shaw, and Katie Kiefer, to be installed at the town beach by Lakeview Nurseries; location to be set by the Facilities Director, his group and the donating group (amendment by K. Menard).
votes.quote: k. menard made a motion to accept the donation gift of the native tree as a memorial to gen ness, cheryl shaw, and katie kiefer to be installed at the town beach by lakeview nurseries.

votes.motion: Nominate A. Lockwood for Chair.
votes.quote: k. menard made a motion to nominate a. lockwood for chair. c. sullivan seconded.

votes.motion: Nominate C. Sullivan for Vice-Chair.
votes.quote: c. shapiro made a motion to nominate c. sullivan for vice-chair. k. menard seconded. roll call vote.motion carried (4-0).

votes.motion: Nominate K. Menard for Clerk.
votes.quote: a. lockwood made a motion to nominate k. menard for clerk. c. sullivan seconded. roll call vote.motion carried (4-0).

votes.motion: Designate K. Menard to represent the Parks Commission on the Master Plan Steering Committee.
votes.quote: a. lockwood made a motion to designate k. menard to represent the parks commission on the steering committee. c. shapiro seconded. roll call vote.motion carried (4-0).

votes.motion: Add the construction end date of June 30, 2024 to the upcoming contract between the Park Commission and the Lunenburg Skate Park Organization.
votes.quote: c. sullivan made a motion to add the construction end date of june 30, 2024 to the up coming contract that will be drafted

meetings.ours_headline: Parks Commission agreed feedback on the Marshall Park schematic design for Walla, keeping a t-ball home in the plan.
Parks Commission heard the Marshall Park schematic design, made no formal votes on it, and approved minutes.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of May 31, 2023 as amended and April 19, 2023.
votes.quote: c. sullivan made a motion to approve the minutes from may 31, 2023 as amended and april 19, 2023. k. menard seconded.roll call vote. motion carried (3-0).

meetings.ours_headline: Parks Commission backed a skate park design, a Marshall Park grant application, and an extra beach lifeguard hire.

votes.motion: Recommend adding an additional part-time, as needed lifeguard, Cole Kiefer, and if licensing comes through, hire another without returning to the Commission.
votes.quote: k. menard made a motion that the parks commission recommend adding an additional part-time, as needed lifeguard, cole kiefer

votes.motion: Present the Skate Park design as presented.
votes.quote: k.menard made a mothon to present the skate park design as presented. c. sullivan seconded. roll call vote.motion carried (4-0).

votes.motion: Support the grant application as discussed.
votes.quote: c. sullivan made a motion to support the grant application as discussed. p. hakey seconded. roll call vote.motion carried (4-0).

meetings.ours_headline: Parks Commission backed a Boys and Girls Club polar plunge and approved its park naming policy.

votes.motion: Support the Boys & Girls Club efforts to work with the Parks for a Polar Plunge.
votes.quote: k. menard made a motion to support the boys & girls efforts to work with the parks for a polar plunge. c. sullivan seconded.

votes.motion: Approve the Parks Commission naming policy as written.
votes.quote: c. sullivan made a motion to approve the naming policy for the parks commission as written. k. menard seconded.

meetings.ours_headline: Parks Commission let Special Olympics use Fitzgerald Field free for six weeks and backed McNally as a capital request.

votes.motion: Allow the Special Olympics to use Fitzgerald Field on Sunday mornings for six weeks through November 5, 2023.
votes.quote: k. menard made a motion to allow the special olympics to use fitzgerald field on sunday mornings for six weeks through november 5, 2023.

votes.motion: Appoint Anita Schiepers to the Park Commission through May 2024.
votes.quote: k. menard motioned and c. sullivan seconded to appoint a. schiepers to the park commission through may 2024. passed unanimously.

votes.motion: Adjourn the meeting at 7:25pm.
votes.quote: k. menard motioned and c. sullivan seconded to adjourn at 7:25pm. roll call: c. sullivan - aye

meetings.ours_headline: Parks Commission agreed to request a placeholder for Northfield conceptual design and keep Marshall Park plans; no formal votes beyond minutes and adjournment.
Parks Commission backed advocating against lumping Parks into facilities for capital planning and approved a skate park letter.
